body.zh: 按分数差距、专业课难度、复试比例等打分比较，帮你想清楚，决定权在你。
body.en: Score options on score gap, exam difficulty, interview weighting and more — the decision stays yours.

question.zh: 我正在考研择校，请帮我比较学校和专业。
question.en: Help me compare postgraduate programmes and universities.

body.zh: 告诉我年份、科目和各题型得分，找出差距在哪、该回炉哪些章节。
body.en: Share the year, subject and section scores to find the gaps and chapters to revisit.

prompt.zh: 我刚做完一套考研真题，帮我复盘。
prompt.en: Help me review a postgraduate entrance exam paper I just completed.

title.en: Set up a weekly progress check

body.zh: 每周日对照阶段目标：完成了什么、落后多少、错题集中在哪。
body.en: Every Sunday, check progress against your plan: what’s done, how far behind, where mistakes cluster.
